tweets.text:
Do we really need more launchpads on EVM chains?

There are @bankrbot, @clanker_world, @virtuals_io - chasing micro caps. 
Virtuals had its moment (late 2024, the peak activity, base:0x4f9fd6be4a90f2620860d680c0d4d5fb53d1a825 traded above $1B). Bankr + Clanker rode the February 2026 AI-agent wave.
They weren't the reason on-chain pumped - they captured the attention economy around it, when the time was right.

Mid-cap? There are maybe two or three that fit: @Uniswap, @legiondotcc, and @virtuals_io (titan launches).
That is the entire list I can point to for high-quality EVM launches.

Then there is @umia_finance.

Launched its own token on its own platform - base:0x56ab53b77f07da3af732150e8aec4783eb5bba7d.

It is the first real futarchy play I have seen on Base.
Every decision is a prediction market. The outcome the market prices highest executes on-chain.
Compare to @MetaDAOProject - which pioneered this on Solana first. The difference is not the mechanism; it is the chain and the thesis.

Solana - is always about attention economy, the chain is more about memes overall. 
Base - is more focused on utility and product, we can see @AskVenice, @dphnAI, @aeonframework type of projects on base.

Watching the first launches closely. In my new article, I'm going to write a detailed research about Umia Finance.

profile_bio.description: 🧵writer | Crypto AI maxi | Narrative Researcher | Sometimes Degen | Only my Own Opinions

quoted_tweet.text:
The base:0x56ab53b77f07da3af732150e8aec4783eb5bba7d auction closed on Sep 2 with a final clearing price of $0.36. 

At that price, 20% of the auction USDC was automatically paired with base:0x56ab53b77f07da3af732150e8aec4783eb5bba7d to seed a Uniswap V4 pool, creating Protocol-Owned Liquidity and enabling trading the moment the auction ended.

In its first 24 hours, the pool handled over $8M in volume across ~1,400 holders. 

Since the liquidity is protocol-owned, every dollar of trading fees flowed straight to the treasury: over $80K on day one. base:0x56ab53b77f07da3af732150e8aec4783eb5bba7d holders control that treasury via decision markets, so they can decide how it's used.

A successful launch does not finish when the auction is over, you need strong liquidity to allow trading the moment the token is live. 

With Umia we addressed this issue, and the system worked as intended.
